mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST (USER_ID, REASON) VALUES (#{userId}, #{reason}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID) WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS "id" ,REASON AS "reason" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" FROM T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT STATUS AS "status" ,ADMIN_NOTE AS "note" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM HANDLED_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "handledAt" FROM T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'CANCELED' ,HANDLED_DAY = NOW() WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT X.ID AS "id" ,X.USER_ID AS "userId" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,X.REASON AS "reason" ,X.STATUS AS "status" ,X.ADMIN_NOTE AS "note" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM X.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "insAt" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM X.HANDLED_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "handledAt" FROM ( (SELECT R.* FROM T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST R WHERE R.STATUS = 'PENDING') UNION ALL (SELECT R.* FROM T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST R WHERE R.STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY R.ID DESC LIMIT 30) ) X JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = X.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN X.STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ,CASE WHEN X.STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN X.ID ELSE -X.ID END
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING'
SELECT ID AS "id" ,USER_ID AS "userId" ,STATUS AS "status" FROM T_MOCK_RESET_REQUEST WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT ID FROM T_USER WHERE ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL
